description: This is a Java class implementing the SearchReadPlatformService interface for the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods for retrieving and searching various entity data (clients, loans, savings, shares, groups, client identifiers) based on search conditions, and constructing complex SQL queries for entity matching and ad hoc search templates. The class integrates with Spring JDBC for database operations and includes mappings for converting ResultSet rows into domain data objects.

classes.name: SearchReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of search service providing data retrieval based on various search criteria, SQL query construction, and mapping database rows to data objects.

methods.name: retriveMatchingData
methods.description: Executes a search query to retrieve matching entities based on specified search conditions, considering user hierarchy and whether exact matching is required.

methods.name: searchSchema
methods.description: Constructs a union SQL query string to match various entity types like clients, loans, savings, shares, client identifiers, and groups, based on search conditions.

methods.name: retrieveAdHocQueryTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template collection of loan products and offices for ad hoc query building.

methods.name: retrieveAdHocQueryMatchingData
methods.description: Executes dynamically generated ad hoc search queries based on user-specified search conditions.
